metaDescription: Order custom sublimation lanyards for vibrant, full-color branding. Perfect for events and daily use. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom sublimation lanyards offer full-color, edge-to-edge printing that won't fade or peel, making them ideal for trade shows, employee IDs, and event credentials. Unlike screen-printed lanyards, sublimation allows for photographic detail and complex gradients across the entire surface. Choose from polyester or satin materials, breakaway or fixed attachments, and add your logo or design in vivid detail. Perfect for marketing directors and safety managers who need durable, professional-looking lanyards that stand out.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation lanyards with full-color printed patterns and metal attachments
